items.title: 56706_Buddy Tate oral history interview
items.q: So we did a thing called "Six Foot-Two Baby" or something with Spoon.

ctx.x: How did Witherspoon get in there?

Well, this was his first thing, too. So the man said, "Well, I got a blues singer, too," says, "and I want you all to back him." So we did a thing called "Six Foot-Two Baby" or something with Spoon. That was one of Spoon's first dates, too. And they brought him in, the record people. And then C.Q. sang, you know, like because Spoon wanted to do his thing, you know, and of course, we played for him. Then

they gave me a big band. Their records didn't get out much. I had it and I don't know whatever -- had a vocal, choral group, sang beautiful harmony. They had the right kind of harmony and I had about 12-piece band and I only had one record and I don't know, it's got lost.
